Title: Resident participation in sustainable tourism planning: evidence from coastal Kerala
Abstract: This paper examines how coastal residents are involved in tourism planning decisions across eleven panchayats.

Title: Participatory budgeting for tourism levies: a natural experiment
Abstract: A natural experiment across 18 municipalities that adopted participatory budgeting for tourism levies at different times.

Title: Measuring empowerment in tourism: a comparison of four instruments
Abstract: Four published empowerment scales are administered to the same sample of 310 residents to assess convergent validity.
